notes: Added current_turn ContextVar with default None and conservative base-turn parsing.
ToolLoggingMiddleware publishes parsed base-turn context and resets it in finally while preserving full X-Request-Id turn logs.
Covered absent/malformed headers, sequential turns, concurrent distinct HTTP turns, exception cleanup, and sync-thread propagation.
No guard policy or job_status behavior was added in Step 2.3.
Added the standalone BlockingWallTracker sequential state machine with the frozen public classes/API and an injected time.monotonic clock.
Sequential tracked waits charge actual elapsed wall time on release; productive gaps are free; less than one second remaining returns exhausted with effective wait zero.
No-policy and no-turn paths preserve the ordinary bounded wait, release is idempotent, new base turns receive fresh budgets, and a tracked record keeps its original configured budget.
No job_status integration, overlapping-wait accounting, or LRU/capacity fallback behavior was added in Step 2.4.
Extended BlockingWallTracker so overlapping positive effective waits share one active window and the original deadline instead of summing requested wait time.
Overlapping acquisitions report live union spend and remaining budget; only positive effective waits increment active_count, and non-final releases leave the shared window open.
The final active release commits the union wall duration capped at the shared deadline; release ordering does not affect the committed charge.

Added deterministic coverage for two/five fully overlapping waits, partial overlap, early release, deadline exhaustion, reordered release, exception/cancellation cleanup, and zero-effective waits, including a real threaded acquire/release case.
No job_status integration, LRU eviction, or capacity fallback behavior was added in Step 2.5.
